recommendations.title: Orders Export and Orders Export (copy) repeat the same calculated columns
recommendations.detail: Orders Export (Sales Performance Overview); Orders Export (copy) (Sales Performance Overview) share at least 5 calculated columns with identical formulas (at least 100% overlap). Filters, sorting and layout are not compared, so they may still differ.
recommendations.action: If the elements only differ by a filter, keep one and filter it with a control or a saved view. Otherwise move the shared calculated columns into one common source and point the others at it.
